payload.posture: Read Matthew 26:31–32 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states after the meal, Jesus cites the struck shepherd, predicts the disciples’ scattering, and says he will go before them into Galilee after rising. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
